title: OVA (Open Virtual Appliance) signature
summary: An OVA file is a tar archive containing an OVF (Open Virtualization Format) descriptor and disk images. The magic is the tar signature (ustar) at offset 257.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: OVA is a tar archive with OVF descriptor + disk images.
OVF descriptor is an XML file describing the VM (CPU, memory, disks, network).
OVA is the standard format for distributing virtual appliances.
Supported by VMware, VirtualBox, and cloud platforms.
